changes_made.explanation: Normalized output descriptions to be more consistent and accurate, focusing on the comparative nature of the generated outputs
Simplified metric variants to base forms (ROUGE-L and ROUGE-2 → ROUGE), removed redundant 'Exact Match (EM)' since EM is already included
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted; ChatGPT was only used as a generation model baseline, not for evaluation
No human evaluation was mentioned in the paper; only automatic metrics were used

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on comparative reasoning tasks with clear NLG components (QA, QG, summarization). All evaluation was done using automatic metrics without human or LLM-as-judge assessment. The metadata needed minor normalization for consistency.
